title: Microbial Products and Biodiesel Research
summary: This cluster consists of research papers and journals related to microbial products and biodiesel. Aggelis G and Papanikolaou S are authors of papers published in FEMS Microbiol Lett and Microbial products. Knothe G Biodiesel is a title related to Prog Energy Combust Sci. The cluster also includes methods and tools such as catalytic carboxylation, comparison, and renewable diesel, which are likely relevant to the research in this field.
